title: Fukanzazengi Part 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Here is a summary of the talk's main teaching in plain language: The talk emphasizes the importance of transformation through Zen practice, which involves letting go of attachments and conditioning to tap into one's true nature. This requires courage to be different, take chances, and give up habits and moods, rather than trying to control or intellectualize it. By doing so, practitioners can cultivate a deeper sense of wisdom and enlightenment that is always present, regardless of external circumstances.
